prospective_limits.exact_prompt_token_count: Not measured during preparation; no inference/tokenizer request made.
prospective_limits.policy: Preserve full upstream command. Record overflow, compaction, timeout or truncation rather than silently shortening instructions.

minimal_acceptance_journey: Actual installed specify invocation produces useful native spec/checklist bytes, retains first output and omissions, and reaches the authentic unanswered-owner clarification boundary. Independent assessment follows. A separate clarify invocation is needed only if specify has not reached that disposition; no invented answers, plan/implementation or all-green checklist are required.
exposure: Supplied authored inputs/specification.json contract plus all fixed source material. No previous generated Markdown, exercise answers, reviews or owner answers supplied.
runtime_gates_pending: Root verifies actual f16/no-repack server health and sustained memory headroom.
Root tokenizes complete expanded command plus actual attachment output and includes all native system/tool/chat overhead and cumulative history/output reserve.
Root freezes the exact prospective command/runtime/time bounds before inference.
Actual generation starts a new explicitly titled session; do not use the noReply preparation session.
frozen_evidence: PREPARATION_MANIFEST.json binds this completed preparation. Later tokenizer/runtime/observations belong in new sibling evidence, never by rewriting this preparation.
